title: YouTube Extended Search with FlashData
description: Search YouTube with up to 700 requested results at the extended-search FlashData rate. Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

query.title: Query
query.description: One search query, e.g. battery recycling explained.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Requires youtube_search_extended access. Get your key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum results (1–700). Actual count may be lower.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: JSON filters, e.g. {"upload_date":"this_week","type":"video"}. See README for supported values.
